title: The Llama 3 Herd of Models
paper_type_zh: 开放权重基础模型谱系报告与数据披露账本
best_for_zh: 研究大规模预训练配比、合成后训练、DPO、reasoning/tool/safety 数据和开放权重审计的读者
one_line: Llama 3.1 discloses a 15.6T-token 50/25/17/8 pretraining mix and six rounds of reward modeling, best-of-10–30 rejection sampling, SFT, and DPO, while releasing weights and guards but not corpora, preferences, reward models, candidates, or item lineage.
Llama 3.1 披露 15.6T token、50/25/17/8 预训练配比，以及六轮 reward model、best-of-10–30 rejection sampling、SFT 与 DPO；它开放权重、推理工具和 Llama Guard 3，但不开放语料、偏好、RM、候选或 item-level lineage。
why: It clearly connects aggregate corpus composition to post-training data objects and verifiers while exposing the gap between open weights and closed records, reward contracts, source rights, contamination controls, and generator-to-checkpoint lineage.
inclusion_reason: A foundational disclosure quantifying a 15.6T-token mixture and six-round RM/rejection-sampling/SFT/DPO pipeline with execution- and process-filtered capability data, released weights and guards, but closed records and lineage.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Llama 3.1 asks how a dense open-weight model family can scale pretraining, long context, multilinguality, coding, reasoning, tool use, instruction following, and safety without relying on a single post-training data source. The report is a key 2024 lineage anchor because it links a quantified pretraining mixture to iterative preference and synthetic-data construction.

Its central audit tension is openness asymmetry. Meta releases pretrained and instruction-tuned weights, model utilities, prompt formats, Llama Guard 3, Prompt Guard, and Code Shield, but not the 15.6T-token corpus, human preferences, SFT records, reward models, rejected candidates, execution environments, or item-level lineage.

Llama 3.1 研究一个 dense 开放权重模型家族如何同时扩展预训练、长上下文、多语言、代码、推理、工具使用、指令遵循和安全，而不依赖单一后训练数据源。该报告是重要的 2024 谱系锚点，因为它把量化预训练配比与迭代偏好和合成数据构造连接起来。

其核心审计张力是开放不对称。Meta 发布 PT/IT 权重、模型工具、提示格式、Llama Guard 3、Prompt Guard 和 Code Shield，却不发布 15.6T-token 语料、人类偏好、SFT 记录、reward model、淘汰候选、执行环境或 item-level lineage。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The construction recipe has two linked layers. Pretraining builds 8B, 70B, and 405B dense models from a 15.6T-token mixture, then progressively extends context to 128K. Post-training repeats six rounds of preference collection, reward modeling, best-of-10–30 rejection sampling, SFT, DPO, and model averaging.

Capability branches turn code execution, final answers, stepwise rewards, Python, MCTS, tool calls, human edits, and safety policies into feedback. The reusable data object is therefore not just a chat pair: it can be a chosen/edited/rejected preference triple, execution trace, reasoning trajectory with step/outcome reward, tool dialog, or safety-labeled conversation.

构造配方有两个相连层次。预训练从 15.6T-token 配比构建 8B、70B、405B dense 模型，再逐步把上下文扩展到 128K。后训练重复六轮偏好收集、reward modeling、best-of-10–30 rejection sampling、SFT、DPO 和模型平均。

能力分支把代码执行、最终答案、stepwise reward、Python、MCTS、工具调用、人类编辑与安全策略转化为反馈。因此可复用的数据对象不只是聊天问答，还可以是 chosen/edited/rejected 偏好三元组、执行轨迹、带 step/outcome reward 的推理链、工具对话或安全标注会话。

title: Method
方法
html:
The disclosed recipe is:

  1. Pretraining corpus and mixture. The 405B model trains on 15.6T text tokens, about 3.8×10^25 FLOPs, and more than 16,000 H100 GPUs. Meta describes publicly available online data, no Meta user data, a December 2023 cutoff, and a final mix of about 50% general knowledge, 25% math/reasoning, 17% code, and 8% multilingual. Source manifests and rights are not released.
  2. Filtering and scale. URL, MinHash document, and repeated-line deduplication combine with PII/adult/unsafe-domain filters, repetition/outlier heuristics, Llama-2-derived quality/domain classifiers, and language identification across 176 languages. AdamW uses peak LR 8e-5, 8,000 warmup steps, decay to 8e-7 over 1.2M steps, and token batches growing 4M→8M→16M.
  3. Long context and annealing. Six progressive stages extend 8K to 128K over about 800B tokens. The final 40M tokens at 128K upsample high-quality sources, linearly anneal LR to zero, and end with checkpoint averaging.
  4. Human preference and RM. For each prompt, annotators compare two responses from two current models, label four preference strengths, and may edit the chosen answer, yielding edited > chosen > rejected. The RM uses qualifying comparisons; absolute counts, checkpoint, rubric, and calibration are closed.
  5. Rejection sampling, SFT, DPO. Usually 10–30 candidates are sampled from a recent or capability-best chat model for human-annotation prompts; the general RM keeps the favorite. Largest-model SFT runs 8.5K–9K steps at LR 1e-5; DPO uses LR 1e-5, beta 0.1, format-token masking, and a 0.2 chosen-sequence NLL term. Six rounds recollect preferences/SFT data. PPO was tested but not adopted.
  6. SFT mixture. More than 25M synthetic fine-tuning examples are reported overall. The final SFT mix is 52.66% general English, 14.89% code, 3.01% multilingual, 8.14% exam-like, 21.19% reasoning/tools, and 0.11% long context.
  7. Capability data. Code uses a 1T-token, >85%-code expert and more than 2.7M synthetic SFT examples, including about 1M execution-feedback and 1.2M backtranslation dialogs, filtered by parsing, linting, compilation, tests, execution, self-verification, and judges. Math uses QA-converted pretraining records, human skill prompts, final-answer checks, self-verification, outcome/stepwise RMs, MCTS, Python, and mistake correction. Tool records cover Brave Search, Python, Wolfram Alpha, file processing, The Stack functions, multi-agent API synthesis, executable calls, and human message-level feedback.
  8. Safety. Human/vendor and synthetic adversarial data, guided mutation, Rainbow Teaming, safety DPO, and refusal rewriting train the policy. Released components include Llama Guard 3—an 8B classifier for 13 MLCommons hazards plus Code Interpreter Abuse—Prompt Guard, and Code Shield. Their training records and internal benchmarks remain closed.

已披露配方如下：

  1. 预训练语料与配比。 405B 模型使用 15.6T text token、约 3.8×10^25 FLOPs 和超过 16,000 张 H100。Meta 称数据来自公开在线内容、不使用 Meta 用户数据，cutoff 为 2023 年 12 月；最终约 50% 通识、25% 数学/推理、17% 代码、8% 多语言。来源清单与权利未发布。
  2. 过滤与规模。 URL、MinHash 文档和重复行去重，结合 PII/成人/不安全域过滤、重复/离群启发式、基于 Llama 2 的质量/领域分类器，以及 176 种语言识别。AdamW 峰值 LR 8e-5，8,000 warmup step，在 1.2M step 衰减到 8e-7，token batch 从 4M→8M→16M。
  3. 长上下文与 annealing。 六个渐进阶段用约 800B token 把 8K 扩展到 128K。最后 40M token 在 128K 上采样高质量来源，LR 线性降到零，最终进行 checkpoint averaging。
  4. 人类偏好与 RM。 每个提示由标注者比较两个当前模型的响应，标四档偏好强度，并可编辑 chosen，形成 edited > chosen > rejected。RM 使用合格比较；绝对数量、checkpoint、rubric 和校准均封闭。
  5. Rejection sampling、SFT、DPO。 对人类标注提示通常从近期或能力最佳 chat 模型采样 10–30 个候选，由通用 RM 选最优。最大模型 SFT 以 LR 1e-5 训练 8.5K–9K step；DPO 使用 LR 1e-5、beta 0.1、format-token masking 和 0.2 chosen-sequence NLL。六轮重复收集偏好/SFT。PPO 被试验但未采用。
  6. SFT 配比。 Model card 报告超过 25M 条合成 fine-tuning 样本。最终 SFT 为 52.66% 通用英语、14.89% 代码、3.01% 多语言、8.14% exam-like、21.19% 推理/工具、0.11% 长上下文。
  7. 能力数据。 代码分支使用 1T token、>85% 代码的 expert，以及超过 2.7M 合成 SFT，其中约 1M execution-feedback、1.2M backtranslation，经 parser、linter、编译、测试、执行、自验证和 judge 过滤。数学使用转为 QA 的预训练记录、人类技能提示、最终答案、自验证、outcome/stepwise RM、MCTS、Python 和错误修正。工具数据覆盖 Brave Search、Python、Wolfram Alpha、文件处理、The Stack 函数、多 agent API 合成、可执行调用及人类 message-level 反馈。
  8. 安全。 人类/vendor 与合成对抗数据、guided mutation、Rainbow Teaming、安全 DPO 和拒绝语气改写训练策略。公开组件包括 8B Llama Guard 3（13 类 MLCommons hazard 加 Code Interpreter Abuse）、Prompt Guard 和 Code Shield；训练记录及内部基准仍封闭。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The paper reports a concrete scale anchor: 15.6T tokens for 405B, about 3.8×10^25 FLOPs, progressive 128K context, more than 25M synthetic fine-tuning examples, and six post-training rounds. The official model card reports 405B Instruct results including MMLU 87.3, GPQA 50.7, HumanEval 89.0, MATH 73.8, API-Bank 92.0, and BFCL 88.5; these are end-model outcomes, not attribution to one data stage.

Safety artifacts are materially open: Llama Guard 3 weights, Prompt Guard, Code Shield, model utilities, and 8B/70B/405B PT/IT weights are released. The paper reports average violation reduction around 65% for Llama Guard 3, while the full English guard setup shows -86% relative violations and +102% relative false refusals, exposing the safety/helpfulness tradeoff.

The contamination analysis estimates overlap of 98% AGIEval, 95% BBH, 96% BoolQ, 85% HellaSwag, 99% QuaC, and 52% Natural Questions. HumanEval, MBPP, MMLU, and MMLU-Pro cannot be usefully assessed by the selected 8-gram method. These findings require caveats around headline benchmarks.

论文给出明确规模锚点：405B 使用 15.6T token、约 3.8×10^25 FLOPs，逐步扩展到 128K，上报超过 25M 合成 fine-tuning 样本并进行六轮后训练。官方 model card 报告 405B Instruct 的 MMLU 87.3、GPQA 50.7、HumanEval 89.0、MATH 73.8、API-Bank 92.0、BFCL 88.5；这些是最终模型结果，不能归因于单一数据阶段。

安全 artifact 有实质开放：Llama Guard 3 权重、Prompt Guard、Code Shield、模型工具以及 8B/70B/405B PT/IT 权重均发布。论文报告 Llama Guard 3 平均违规率相对下降约 65%；完整英语 guard 设置为违规 -86%、误拒 +102%，显示安全—有用性权衡。

污染分析估计 AGIEval 98%、BBH 95%、BoolQ 96%、HellaSwag 85%、QuaC 99%、Natural Questions 52% 存在重叠。所选 8-gram 方法无法有效评估 HumanEval、MBPP、MMLU、MMLU-Pro。因此解读 headline benchmark 必须带污染 caveat。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
Llama 3's report is unusually specific about aggregate data composition and alignment sequencing. It connects web-scale domain mixing, progressive long-context training, human preference editing, learned ranking, best-of-K distillation, SFT, DPO, execution-based code filtering, process-filtered mathematics, tool trajectories, and deployable safeguards in one lineage.

Its value relative to the later Llama 4 Herd report is historical and architectural: Llama 3 is the 2024 dense-model recipe and predecessor disclosure. Llama 4 is a successor with different architecture and data recipe, so the two Cards form lineage rather than duplicate coverage.

Llama 3 报告对聚合数据配比与 alignment 顺序给出了少见的具体披露。它把 web-scale 领域混合、渐进长上下文、人类偏好编辑、学习式排序、best-of-K 蒸馏、SFT、DPO、执行式代码过滤、过程式数学过滤、工具轨迹和可部署安全组件放入同一谱系。

相对后续 Llama 4 Herd 报告，本 Card 的价值在历史与架构定位：Llama 3 是 2024 年 dense 模型配方及前代披露；Llama 4 是架构和数据配方不同的后继。因此两张 Card 构成谱系，而不是重复覆盖。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
The 15.6T corpus is not open. Aggregate “publicly available online” provenance and 50/25/17/8 percentages do not provide URLs, snapshots, source rights, opt-out handling, per-language/geography allocation, removed records, or reusable corpus terms. Human annotations, preference comparisons/edits, SFT records, rejected candidates, RMs, math/code/tool traces, tests, and safety benchmarks are also closed.

Contamination remains material and partly unresolved. The report's 8-gram method estimates very high overlap for several benchmarks and cannot assess HumanEval, MBPP, MMLU, or MMLU-Pro reliably. Related Llama models generate, judge, rewrite, rank, and self-verify much synthetic data, creating correlated generator/judge error without independent calibration.

Open weights and utilities are not open data or an open training stack. The custom Llama 3.1 Community License imposes attribution/naming, Acceptable Use, and a separate-license condition above 700M MAU and is not an OSI license. No item-level IDs link source record, rights, filters, generator, candidate set, RM/judge score, alignment round, and final checkpoint. Later Llama 4 repository content must not be back-attributed to this recipe.

15.6T 语料并未开放。“公开在线”来源与 50/25/17/8 聚合比例没有给出 URL、快照、来源权利、opt-out、语言/地域分配、删除记录或可复用语料条款。人类标注、偏好比较/编辑、SFT 记录、淘汰候选、RM、数学/代码/工具轨迹、测试与安全基准同样封闭。

污染风险显著且部分无法解决。报告的 8-gram 方法对多个基准估计出极高重叠，又无法可靠评估 HumanEval、MBPP、MMLU、MMLU-Pro。相关 Llama 模型同时生成、判断、改写、排序和自验证大量合成数据，造成未经独立校准的 generator/judge 相关误差。

开放权重和工具不等于开放数据或开放训练栈。定制 Llama 3.1 Community License 包含归属/命名、Acceptable Use 和超过 700M MAU 的单独许可条件，并非 OSI license。没有 item-level ID 连接来源记录、权利、过滤、生成器、候选集、RM/judge 分数、alignment 轮次与最终 checkpoint。后续仓库中的 Llama 4 内容不能反向归因于该配方。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
This report is a useful template for documenting frontier recipes at three levels: aggregate corpus composition, capability-specific record construction, and feedback/optimizer sequencing. Dataset builders can reuse its distinctions among human preferences, edited targets, rejection-sampled SFT, execution-verified code, process-filtered reasoning, tool trajectories, and safety records.

For stronger auditability, every record should carry source/license identity, generator checkpoint and decoding, candidate-set membership, verifier/RM version and score, failure/rejection reason, round membership, and final checkpoint ancestry. Open-weight releases should separately enumerate which weights, code, data, rewards, tests, and environments are actually reusable.

该报告是记录前沿配方的实用模板，可分为三层：聚合语料组成、能力专用记录构造、反馈/优化器顺序。数据构造者可复用其对人类偏好、编辑 target、rejection-sampled SFT、执行验证代码、过程过滤推理、工具轨迹与安全记录的区分。

若要提高可审计性，每条记录都应携带来源/许可证、生成器 checkpoint 与解码、候选集成员、验证器/RM 版本与分数、失败/淘汰原因、轮次成员和最终 checkpoint ancestry。开放权重发布还应分别列明权重、代码、数据、奖励、测试和环境中哪些真正可复用。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Anchor pretraining claims to the official recipe: 405B, 15.6T tokens, about 3.8×10^25 FLOPs, and a 50/25/17/8 general/reasoning/code/multilingual mix.
  • Keep the six-round sequence explicit: preference collection → RM → best-of-10–30 rejection sampling → 8.5K–9K-step SFT → DPO → model averaging; PPO was not adopted.
  • Separate capability contracts: execution and generated tests for code; answer/step RMs, MCTS, and Python for math; executable APIs plus human feedback for tools; human/LLM policies and guards for safety.
  • More than 25M synthetic SFT examples and over 2.7M code examples are reported, but total human, preference, rejected, and per-round records are unknown.
  • Weights, utilities, Llama Guard 3, Prompt Guard, and Code Shield are released; the corpus, preferences, RMs, candidates, tests, and training stack are not.
  • Treat llama-4-herd-2025 as a related successor. Preserve Llama 3's distinct dense 2024 recipe, license, contamination findings, and item-lineage gaps.

• 预训练结论绑定官方配方：405B、15.6T token、约 3.8×10^25 FLOPs，以及通识/推理/代码/多语言 50/25/17/8 配比。
  • 明确六轮顺序：偏好收集→RM→best-of-10–30 rejection sampling→8.5K–9K-step SFT→DPO→模型平均；PPO 未被采用。
  • 区分能力契约：代码依赖执行和生成测试；数学依赖答案/step RM、MCTS 与 Python；工具依赖可执行 API 加人类反馈；安全依赖人类/LLM policy 与 guard。
  • 报告超过 25M 合成 SFT 和超过 2.7M 代码样本，但人类、偏好、淘汰和逐轮记录总量未知。
  • 权重、工具、Llama Guard 3、Prompt Guard、Code Shield 已发布；语料、偏好、RM、候选、测试和训练栈未发布。
  • 将 llama-4-herd-2025 视为相关后继；保留 Llama 3 独立的 2024 dense 配方、许可证、污染发现和 item-lineage 缺口。
